journey.name: receive primary quote
journey.description: Proves a receive the channel cannot take goes through the primary only after the user approves its fee: on an empty wallet the primary opens a channel, and above the channel's inbound it splices more in. Precondition: see README.md.

actions.action: Open Receive, switch to the Spending tab and tap the Lightning receive button
Verify the "Review receive fee" screen (testTag "PrimaryReceiveConfirm") shows "PrimaryReceiveFee" and "PrimaryReceiveMin"
Tap "PrimaryReceiveApprove" and verify the receive QR shows a Lightning invoice for 20000 sats
Pay the invoice from the second wallet and verify the received sheet and a spending balance of at least the minimum shown
Open Receive again, edit the Spending invoice to an amount above the channel's inbound capacity and continue
Approve the fee, pay the invoice from the second wallet, and verify the payment arrives without a second channel in Settings › Advanced › Lightning connections
